verdict.rationale: The IRS does publish machine-readable interface definitions for Modernized e-File: per-tax-year XML schema packages and business rules, plus a SOAP A2A toolkit containing WSDLs. These are an equivalent to OpenAPI, but distribution is gated behind the registered-user/e-Services portal, and the toolkit is sent on email request. Probes of every standard OpenAPI/Swagger path return 404. missing for 10: a publicly downloadable spec without enrollment, an OpenAPI or other modern REST spec, an interactive API reference, and a public developer portal (developer.irs.gov and api.irs.gov do not resolve).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Schemas and business rules are now available through the registered user portal and your e-services mailbox
MeF uses the widely accepted Extensible Markup Language (XML) format.
